trivy_image_both: {tool}: set only one of imageRef and imageTarball.
trivy_image_ref_invalid: {tool}: imageRef {value} is not a valid image reference (no spaces, not starting with a dash).
trivy_image_tarball_invalid: {tool}: imageTarball {value} is not a valid path.
trivy_image_tarball_missing: {tool}: the image tarball {file} does not exist. Build the image and save it with docker save; JGates never builds or pulls it.
trivy_image_only_vulnerabilities: Final-image mode scans vulnerabilities only; {capability} is not credited in this mode.
trivy_image_limitation: Final-image mode: needs the vulnerability database (network) and Trivy, native or in the sidecar image through a running container runtime; without them the stage is blocked, never passed. The scan itself is not cancellable once started; the stage timeout bounds it.
trivy_image_condition: Scans the final image {target} with trivy image.
trivy_image_no_invocation: The plan has no Trivy image invocation for the instance {tool}.
trivy_image_blocked: The Trivy image scan could not run.
trivy_image_missing_tool: {reason}. Install Trivy (https://trivy.dev/latest/getting-started/installation/) or start the container runtime and prepare the sidecar image with: jgates tools prepare.
trivy_image_reason_completed: Trivy {version}: {count} finding(s) in the final image (runner: {runner}).
